waiting at N100 with part absent, air ok, two-hand released: the step records [0, 1, 0] and the client reads TC3's three labels with them
a part arriving turns record 1 on; two-hand still released holds N100
the slide sticks and times out extending: one MANUAL_RESET alarm sourced to the slide, dated today, blocking; the Unit's diagnostic is TC3's CYL_NOT_EXTENDED and names the slide's extended sensor
§8.3(b): START is refused, and says why
one operator reset: the event is closed into the ring with its gone time, nothing blocks, the Unit has no diagnostic
the same START is accepted once nothing blocks
the ram failing at N200 is reported, not adopted: one closed AUTO_RESET ring entry sourced to the ram, nothing blocks, and the Unit's own diagnostic stays clear while the operator decides
a fresh AUTO session's rows are the clean path's steps, in the order they were first entered, on the controller and as published
the settle row records at least its declared delay; parked at N100 the cursor points at N100's row
within one mode session a re-run keeps its rows
MANUAL starts a new session: no rows, the epoch moved, nothing published
the ram failing at N200 marks N200's row as a warning, with a note naming the reason and the ram; no row is an error
re-entering N200 without a fault clears its mark and its note
TC3's FB_DigitalInputCM on the controller: Value follows the part stimulus both ways at good Quality, published as a digital input
held still by the fault injection, the slide times out extending: TC3's CYL_NOT_EXTENDED on the Unit, the slide and the alarm, naming _101B301A, after the declared 500 ms and not before
the ram held at N110: the Unit's own diagnostic is the ram's INTERLOCK_DROPPED (TC3 _M_RollupHold), no error, not timed out
TC3's SetAreaSafe: the door holds on INTERLOCK_DROPPED when air goes, does not time out or fault while held, the press reports it, and the stroke completes when air returns

TC3's N220: released part-way through the dwell, the dwell stands still on its named condition with no fault; past its expected time it is reported stalled; pressed again, the part is pressed for the declared dwell in total, not the dwell plus the pause

TC3's start latch: the part arriving after the two-hand press does not start the stroke - N100 still waits, nothing latched
a fresh press with the part there: the step moves, the stall and its diagnostic clear
